title: Delegation, revocation and expiry remain authoritative under concurrency
claim: The authority subsystem can issue, delegate, attenuate, expire and revoke capabilities so that every effect is evaluated against the currently legitimate authority chain, with no stale-capability window that silently creates an unauthorized effect.
null_hypothesis: Delegation is safe only in static examples; revocation, expiry, nested delegation and concurrent in-flight work create unavoidable stale-authority effects or ambiguous ownership.
rivals: Short-lived conventional tokens plus centralized authorization provide the same or better revocation semantics.
The system achieves zero stale effects only by synchronously blocking all work on a single authority service, destroying continuity.
Nested delegation is unnecessary complexity and a flatter role model is safer.
mechanism: Capabilities are version-bound, scope-attenuating and non-amplifying; effect eligibility includes an authority freshness rule, and revocation/expiry changes invalidate stale paths before commitment or force explicit unresolved/revalidation state.
scope: Delegation chains up to the frozen depth, concurrent revocation/expiry, approval delegation, retries and in-flight Actions across both public domains and generated authority graphs.
predictions: Delegation never increases scope beyond the delegator capability.
Revoked or expired capability paths create zero post-boundary forbidden effects.
Concurrent revoke-versus-execute races have a deterministic winner rule and never silently accept a stale authority path.
Cycles or conflicting delegation paths fail explicitly rather than granting by accident.
Historical replay can reconstruct the authority version that was legitimately used without treating it as currently valid.
falsifiers: Any delegated capability is broader than its parent authority.
Any effect commits after the frozen revocation/expiry boundary using only a stale authority path.
A concurrency schedule allows both revoke and a conflicting stale commit to be treated as legitimate.
An authority cycle or ambiguous path grants an effect without an explicit resolution rule.

experiment.summary: State-machine experiment over nested delegation, attenuation, expiry, revocation, approvals, concurrent execution and replay.
steps: Freeze authority-clock semantics and the exact commit boundary at which revocation/expiry becomes effective.
Generate authority DAGs, nested delegations, expirations and action attempts.
Generate revoke/execute races and crash/retry schedules.
Compare legitimacy with an immutable reference authority model.
Measure safe progress separately from safety so global serialization cannot masquerade as a successful security design.
Inject non-attenuating delegation, stale-cache and revoke-race mutants.

oracle: Immutable reference authority DAG with explicit scope intersection, version, logical clock, revocation boundary, expiry and deterministic conflict semantics.
baseline: Conventional short-lived capability/token system backed by a centralized policy/authorization service with the same freshness and availability objectives.

support_if: 100% generated revoke/execute races match the independent authority oracle.
reject_if: Any stale/revoked/expired authority produces a forbidden effect or any child delegation amplifies authority.
inconclusive_if: The corpus lacks nested delegation, expiry and concurrent revocation, or safety is achieved only by a test harness that prevents races from occurring.
invalid_if: Candidate wall-clock calls are reused by the oracle without a frozen clock model, or revocation semantics are changed after observing race results.

python_hypothesis_role.strategy: Generate authority DAGs and temporal/concurrent action schedules; shrink stale-capability and scope-amplification failures.
python_hypothesis_role.mutation_proof: Disable attenuation, keep a stale authority cache after revocation, and reorder the revoke/commit boundary; all mutants must be detected.

stop_conditions: If deterministic revocation cannot coexist with useful safe progress in the frozen envelope, reject/narrow before adding richer constitutional authority.
